captureSafety.textPolicy: Tooling, vendor/protected sources, and the newly derived sender are 7-bit ASCII without BOM and use one LF or CRLF style. The existing TCP source remains ASCII/no-BOM and its physical EOL traits and raw hash are recorded without a uniform-EOL claim. Gate-B writable Network text and generated Include headers may retain vendor single-byte high characters but must have no BOM and must use one LF or CRLF style. Other protected Network artifacts retain exact raw hashes; binary artifacts are raw-only.
captureSafety.orphanStagePolicy: A pre-existing or failed same-output temp blocks retry and is never auto-deleted; inspect and remove it explicitly. Only a final raw, strict JSON, and seal reread follows the atomic move.
